summary: Specifies requirements for Delegated Path Validation (DPV) and Delegated Path Discovery (DPD) of public key certificates, which let a client hand certificate-checking work to a server. It also specifies requirements for managing the policies they use.

eli5.summary: Checking that a digital ID is trustworthy takes work. This document lists what is needed so a small device can ask a helper server to do the checking.

questions: how can a server validate certificate chains for a client
